note: Testnet genesis: every role goes to the deployer, which forwards reserve (X-Foundation) and treasury (X-Treasury) to the beacon. Mainnet: give each non-beacon role its own wallet. Sum must be exactly 1,000,000,000 RNG. Operator validators bond 4 x stake (100,000 RNG) from day one: rank is capped bond, so a newcomer has to bond as much to outrank them (a quarter of the seats go by seniority).
